g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Reach the relevant post directly through a Google search with Reddit appended, instead of
searching inside Reddit, when a problem is targeted. → Get results targeted to the specifi
c problem being faced rather than generalized search results.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Use technical-help subreddits as an alternative to Stack Overflow when stuck on a problem
or needing other input. → Solve a problem that was defined before logging in, so that the
session ends with the problem solved.

g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式

s targeted to the specific problem being faced rather than generalized search results.
